map.根据临床特征和病理检查判读肾病综合征的病理类型及治疗方向: Interpret the pathological type and treatment direction of nephrotic syndrome from clinical features and pathological findings
map.提示：肾病综合征诊断需大量蛋白尿(≥3.5g/d)和低白蛋白血症(<30g/L): Note: Diagnosing nephrotic syndrome requires heavy proteinuria (≥3.5 g/d) and hypoalbuminemia (<30 g/L). Renal biopsy is the gold standard for defining pathology. Children with first-episode nephrotic syndrome may trial steroids first, with biopsy if unresponsive; adults should undergo biopsy early. For learning reference only. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：肾病综合征病理分型: 📚 Deep Dive: Nephrotic Syndrome Pathological Typing
map.中老年+膜性改变+IgG 颗粒沉积+上皮下钉突→膜性肾病，匹配度约 85%。: Middle-aged/elderly + membranous change + IgG granular deposits + subepithelial spikes → membranous nephropathy, match ~85%.
map.儿童+光镜近正常+足突融合+免疫阴性→微小病变，激素敏感。: Childhood + near-normal light microscopy + foot process effacement + immunonegative → minimal change disease, steroid-sensitive.
map.光镜+免疫荧光+电镜三联，结合年龄与起病急缓。: Light + immunofluorescence + electron microscopy triad, combined with age and onset rapidity.
map.不同病理治疗与预后各异，指导免疫抑制策略。: Different pathologies require different treatments and prognoses, guiding immunosuppression strategy.
